name: Mississippi Farm Tables
old_description: Discover Timeless Beauty and Craftsmanship with Mississippi Farm Tables
about:
Mississippi Farm Tables operates from Carthage, Mississippi. The company was founded by Mark and Helen, whose story began with Mark's upbringing in Ireland where the kitchen table served as the family nucleus. After community work in London and a rekindled romance in France, Mark discovered woodworking under a master artisan in rural France. The couple later relocated to Mississippi to establish the business.

The workshop produces custom farmhouse dining tables, chairs, and a range of occasional tables including coffee, sofa, console, and end tables, as well as benches. Each piece is handcrafted to order, with customers selecting dimensions, shape, wood species, and finish. To date, the shop has completed nearly 500 tables.

The company serves residential customers seeking heirloom-quality furniture for dining rooms, living rooms, and entryways. Its tables are marketed to families looking to create gathering spaces, with no commercial or industrial clients mentioned.

The founders state their mission is to revive the tradition of family meals and meaningful conversation around the table. A separate initiative, Coffee Tables for Cancer, directs 10 percent of proceeds from coffee table sales to cancer research funding.

name: Mississippi Silicon
old_description: Mississippi Silicon is the first domestic manufacturer of raw silicon metal built in the past 40 years and produces approximately 10% of all silicon metal used in the United States.
about:
Mississippi Silicon operates a silicon metal production facility in Burnsville, Mississippi. The plant launched in late 2015, becoming the first new domestic silicon metal smelter built in the United States in four decades. The company is structured as a partnership between Rima Holding USA, Inc. (the majority owner, linked to Brazilian ferroalloy producer Rima Industrial S/A) and Clean Tech I LLC, a group of strategic investors and financial advisers.

The facility produces raw silicon metal using submerged electric arc furnaces that reduce quartz or gravel (SiO₂) with a carbon source to yield 99% pure molten silicon, which is tapped in batches. Mississippi Silicon invested over $200 million in the Burnsville site and now supplies roughly 10% of the silicon metal consumed in the U.S. The operation emphasizes modern furnace controls, proprietary process techniques, and automated off-gas containment to achieve low-cost, high-quality output.

The company sells silicon metal to customers that serve automotive, electronics, steel, and a broad range of consumer, industrial, and commercial markets across North America and globally. Automotive manufacturing is cited as a key end-use sector, alongside electronics and steel production.

Mississippi Silicon was established to restore domestic silicon metal supply, leveraging low-cost Tennessee Valley Authority electricity, proximity to raw-material sources in Mississippi, Alabama, and Kentucky, and advanced automation to become one of the world’s lowest-cost and highest-quality producers. The venture also aims to create jobs in northeast Mississippi.

name: Mississippi Solar, LLC
old_description: Energy Independence – because security and peace of mind shouldn’t be optional
about:
Mississippi Solar, LLC is based in Eupora, Mississippi. The company was founded in 2008 by Will and Carolyn Hegman and officially registered with the Mississippi Secretary of State in 2009. It was the first commercial electrical contractor in the state to receive a Specialty Wind & Solar classification. Today the business is owned and operated by John and Virginia Wilbanks, both Mississippi natives, and remains family-owned.

The firm designs and installs turn-key solar photovoltaic and battery-backup systems for residential and commercial customers across Mississippi. It also sells, installs, and services Generac home and business standby generators in more than 20 counties, and fits Level 2 and 3 EV charging stations, energy-management thermostats, and LP-tank monitoring. The company acts as a commercial electrical contractor and residential builder, handling permitting, project management, and ongoing system monitoring.

Mississippi Solar serves homeowners, businesses, farms, and institutional clients. Early projects included a poultry farm, a sports arena, and the state's first commercial utility-scale solar PV system as well as the first grid-tie and grid-tie-with-battery installations under the TVA Generation Partners program. The company also supports generator customers in counties such as Lafayette, Pontotoc, Lee, and Lowndes.

The company emphasizes its local roots and code expertise, NABCEP-certified installers, and status as a Generac Power Pro Elite Plus dealer. It backs installations with a 25-year module warranty through REC Solar, lifetime system monitoring, and a five-year workmanship warranty. Its stated mission is to empower customers with reliable, worry-free energy independence, sustainability, and backup power.

name: Missoula Bench Builder
old_description: “I want a beautiful, custom piece of furniture that’s crafted from reclaimed materials… is there anybody that can do that?”
about:
Missoula Bench Builder operates from Missoula, Montana, where founder Ryan Hollingsworth designs and builds custom furniture from reclaimed materials sourced from the state’s historic structures. The business began as a solo woodworking venture focused on preserving local history through functional pieces.

The shop produces one-of-a-kind tables, bookcases, bars, benches, and other furniture using a three-step collaborative process: clients select reclaimed materials, Hollingsworth develops a design, and the finished piece is delivered. All work is performed in-house, with each item handcrafted to the customer’s specifications.

The company serves residential clients and interior designers seeking distinctive, story-rich furnishings. Past projects include an eight-foot barnwood bookcase with adjustable shelves, a rustic high-top bar for a home entertainment area, and an entryway bench crafted from reclaimed barn flooring.

Missoula Bench Builder differentiates itself through responsibly reclaimed materials, fully custom designs, and the “Montana Made” provenance of every piece built personally by Hollingsworth.

about:
Missouri Medical Supply, Inc. was established in 1996 in St. Louis, Missouri, to provide high-quality home medical equipment and services that help individuals maintain independence and quality of life at home. The company operates from its location in St. Louis.

The firm supplies a range of home medical equipment and acts as an authorized Medicare provider and a contracted provider for numerous insurance companies. It handles Medicare claims processing and insurance billing for customers, serving healthcare facilities and home-care patients alike.

Its customer base includes hospitals, nursing homes, assisted living facilities, rehabilitation facilities, dialysis centers, and home care agencies across the region. The company focuses on the healthcare and home-healthcare sectors, providing equipment and services to both institutional and residential clients.

Missouri Medical Supply emphasizes a quick and easy Medicare claims process and offers state-of-the-art equipment for independent living. The business was founded to address the need for reliable home medical equipment and supportive services for those requiring assistance with daily living.

name: Missouri Reclaimed Furniture
old_description: Furnishing homes in Missouri and beyond with the unique beauty of reclaimed barn wood.
about:
Missouri Reclaimed Furniture operates from Springfield, Missouri, where founder David builds custom pieces from salvaged barn wood. The business grew from his passion for the rich patina and history embedded in each timber, and a commitment to environmentally responsible deconstruction and reuse of quality materials. David brings experience and tradition to his trade while maintaining the quality and integrity of the reclaimed wood.

The shop produces customized cabinetry, cabinet resurfacing, custom furniture, wood flooring replacement, and wood door repair. Every item is handcrafted to the client’s specifications, with the reclaimed wood’s rustic character ensuring that no two pieces are alike. The company describes its work as “meticulous care just for you,” though scale details such as facility size, headcount, or annual volume are not publicly disclosed.

The company serves residential customers throughout Missouri and beyond, furnishing homes with one-of-a-kind furniture and built-ins. Its project examples focus on homeowners seeking character-rich conversation pieces rather than commercial or industrial clients.

David emphasizes that the time-worn wood has a story that continues in each creation, positioning the reuse of salvaged material as both an aesthetic and ecological differentiator. The firm’s stated aim is to add character or a conversation piece to each home through carefully customized work.

name: Mobius Materials
old_description: See how Mobius sources certified parts in under two weeks — book a live walkthrough with our team.
about:
Mobius Materials is based in Richmond, Virginia. The company was founded by Margaret Upshur, who serves as CEO. Upshur started the business after experiencing the waste of excess electronic components and high procurement costs while operations at an IoT module manufacturer; she created Mobius to fix that breakdown and return unused parts to the supply chain.

The company operates as a distributor and reseller of electronic components, specializing in verified integrated circuits (ICs) from major manufacturers such as Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, Vishay, Murata, Onsemi, Microchip, STMicroelectronics, and NXP Semiconductors. It sources certified parts, tests them for authenticity, and also purchases excess inventory from manufacturers. The platform provides a marketplace for buying and selling components, with services including bill-of-materials (BOM) optimization and contract manufacturing services. Millions of parts are listed in stock across the supported manufacturer lines.

Mobius serves electronics manufacturers, including IoT module makers and hardware manufacturers. Customers include CEOs and operations leaders at manufacturing companies who need to reduce component costs and manage excess inventory. For example, Hailey N., CEO of a manufacturer, reported saving 25% on BOM costs, and Kendell W., a Manufacturing & Operations Leader, increased excess inventory sales from fewer than two parts per month to over ten orders monthly.

The company differentiates itself by vetting suppliers and comprehensively testing part authenticity, offering 10–70% off common parts at market rates, and providing access to rare stock from other manufacturers' excess. Its stated mission is to improve manufacturers' P&L and get unused parts back into the supply chain.

name: Modern Edge Metal Fabrication, INC
old_description: Modern Edge Metal Fabrication is a full-service professional shop serving midcoast Maine and beyond. We specialize in architectural, structural, marine, and production fabrication.
about:
Modern Edge Metal Fabrication operates from a 6,000-square-foot shop in West Bath, Maine. The company traces its roots to 2015 when Luke Winne, a Georgetown native who grew up around his father’s machine shop, launched a one-man operation out of his dad’s 16-by-24-foot building after a decade honing his craft in Montana. Winne incorporated the business in 2020, and his wife Mandy joined the family-owned venture in 2021.

The shop provides full-service metal fabrication — architectural, structural, marine, and production work — using MIG, TIG, and stick welding (including portable units), a manual lathe, knee mill, 48-inch sheet metal brake (11-gauge mild steel capacity), 80-ton ironworker, 13-by-21-inch band saw, plasma cutting, and 3D modeling. A small team of craftsmen handles design, engineering, fabrication, finishing, and installation in-house.

Customers include general contractors, architects, marine contractors, shipyards, furniture designers, and agricultural operators such as wild blueberry and vegetable farms. The company has fabricated and installed over 8,000 lineal feet of cable railing in midcoast Maine and built the 18-foot Cape Elizabeth Lighthouse replica for the Maine Maritime Museum’s permanent exhibit.

Winne founded Modern Edge to turn a childhood passion for metalworking into a business built on long-term relationships and word-of-mouth referrals. The firm emphasizes a design-through-install workflow, mirror-finish stainless capabilities with in-house passivation, and a proprietary cable rail system priced competitively with national brands.

name: Modern Furniture Manufacturing Company
old_description: We’ve been supplying commercial & wholesale custom millwork for over 20 years –
about:
Modern Furniture Manufacturing Company operates from Lindenhurst, New York, where it has been supplying commercial and wholesale custom millwork for over two decades. The company manages every phase of a project in-house, employing its own installers, delivery fleet, estimators, and designers.

The shop fabricates a wide range of millwork products including cabinetry, casework, countertops, workstations, built-ins, and specialty items such as nurse stations, teller counters, and exam room components. Materials processed span wood, veneer, solid surface, stone, plastic laminate, melamine, mica, and thermofoil, with brand-name laminates from Formica, Wilsonart, and Nevamar and solid surfaces from Corian, LG Hausys, and Silestone.

Its client base covers nearly every segment of commercial construction: retail stores, hospitals and medical facilities, educational institutions, financial centers, hotels, and religious centers. The company also works with contractors and property owners on custom projects that require precise color, material, and quality matching.

Leadership emphasizes superior quality, deadline readiness, exemplary customer service, and competitive pricing as the factors that distinguish the firm. The team includes veterans of operations, production, finance, and purchasing who oversee fabrication, drafting, and installation to ensure projects ship on time or earlier.

name: Modern Metal Solutions, LLC
old_description: Modern Metal Solutions specializes in designing, fabricating, and installing
about:
Modern Metal Solutions, LLC is a family-owned metal fabrication shop based in Hudson, New Hampshire. The company serves the Greater Boston and New England regions, though it considers select projects farther afield. No founding year or founder names are disclosed in public materials.

The shop designs, fabricates, and installs custom architectural and ornamental metalwork, including stairs, railings, doors, range hoods, fireplace enclosures, and decorative scrollwork. Its craftspeople blend traditional hand techniques with modern technology to produce detailed drawings, fabricate components, apply finishes, and handle on-site installation. The operation manages the full project lifecycle from concept through final installation, but facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not published.

Modern Metal Solutions works primarily with architects and builders on custom installations. A noted project includes the 2022 Burpee Hill Construction job in Newbury, New Hampshire, designed by Marcus Gleysteen Architects. The firm focuses on residential and commercial projects that require intricate metal detailing.

The company emphasizes a consultative, seamless experience, positioning itself as a partner that integrates with the client's team. It highlights a commitment to flawless execution, innovation on difficult designs, and a no-shortcuts philosophy that combines hours of handwork with custom technological solutions when needed.
